contract.content: Profile and preference reads are independent and may run concurrently.
Actors and projects have required string tenantId fields. A read requires the same tenant.
Cache timestamps are finite epoch milliseconds. Entries expire at expiresAt, including equality.
read performs an independent read and returns a promise. Results retain input order regardless of completion order.
The caller owns cancellation. Requests forward its AbortSignal unchanged.
attempt is the number of attempts already used. The caller supplies positive integer maximumAttempts.
Rows have unique numeric IDs sorted ascending. The cursor is exclusive and limit is a positive integer.
totalMicros is a bigint. The wire field is a base-ten string, including values above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
retries is an optional nonnegative integer or null. Zero disables retries; null and undefined select three.
lock resolves to a synchronous release function. The lock covers the entire write and releases on success or failure.
database.query binds positional parameters separately from SQL. name is arbitrary user input.
scores is a dense array of finite numbers. Sorting returns a descending copy and leaves the input unchanged.
The runtime supports Object.hasOwn. An absent displayName preserves the value; an own null value explicitly clears it. Inherited properties are ignored.

finding.title: Major dependency bump to ui-kit ^2.0.0 may introduce breaking changes
finding.body: ui-kit is raised from ^1.4.0 to ^2.0.0, a semver major bump that by convention signals breaking API or behavior changes. This diff provides no evidence that consumers of ui-kit in this repo have been updated for v2 compatibility. Verify the v2 changelog and confirm all call sites compile and behave correctly before merging.

finalFindings.title: Preserve compatibility with runtimes lacking Object.hasOwn
finalFindings.body: Object.hasOwn is an ES2022 API and can fail in older supported runtimes, preventing profile patches from being applied. Retain the hasOwnProperty.call implementation or require a runtime that provides Object.hasOwn.

initialFixturePair.conclusion: The optional-field case omitted the runtime contract from the model-visible diff. Its compatibility warning does not demonstrate a false alarm under that evidence.

limitations: Silence describes final Postil reviews after filtering, not an absence of model-generated findings. Suppressed findings and reasons are retained separately.
